wholeSystem.headline: The whole ordering system, on one page.
wholeSystem.subhead: Take pickup, delivery and table bookings on your own site — and keep the whole ticket. Free for your first {cap} orders every month, and unlimited the moment you add any paid feature.

take.1: Your own ordering page, plus a button for the website you already have
take.2: An order screen for any Android tablet, with a ring staff can hear
take.3: Pickup, delivery and table bookings, each with their own hours
take.4: Delivery zones you draw yourself, with your own fee per zone

keep.title: Keep the customer

keep.2: Store credit and rewards that bring people back for a second order

standout.title: Things the delivery apps simply don't do

1.title: An AI that answers the phone
1.body: It takes the order while your kitchen keeps cooking, and never puts a caller on hold.

2.title: Your own app, both stores
2.body: Your name and your logo on the customer's phone — not a listing inside someone else's app.

3.title: Card money, straight to you
3.body: Online payments land in your own account. No holding period, no middleman.

ownYourOrders.subhead: Stop handing a third of every delivery order to an app. Take orders on your own site, keep the full ticket, and turn one-time customers into regulars you actually own.

included.4: Delivery zones and fees you draw and set yourself

combineDontChoose.headline: Combine, don't choose.
combineDontChoose.subhead: The delivery apps are good at one thing: finding you new customers. They are an expensive way to serve the same regulars over and over. Use both, for what each is actually good at.

1.title: Stay on the apps
1.body: Keep {apps} exactly as they are. They still bring you first-time customers.

2.title: Put a code in every bag
2.body: A small card in the bag invites that customer to order direct next time.

3.title: Repeat orders come direct
3.body: They reorder on your own page, at your prices, with no commission taken.

4.title: You keep the customer
4.body: Their details are yours — so you can bring them back whenever you want.
